name: Candace Okimura
caption: A 24-year-old Okinawan joshi wrestler, 5'4" and 112 pounds, soft-spoken and a babyface, whose mother was a joshi wrestler and whose father a yakuza assassin; applied on 8 January 2007 with Devil Matsumoto as her tag partner.

tenures.source: Her own application in the fed's application thread, 8 January 2007.

name: Devil Matsumoto
caption: Candace Okimura's partner in the tag team Asian Invasion, who finishes with an electric chair drop into Candace's moonsault.

tenures.source: Named in Candace Okimura's application and sample roleplay, 8 January 2007.

name: Deborah Mackey
caption: A backstage interviewer for the VENUS Wrestling Alliance's B1TCHIN' showcase, seen interviewing Victoria Hawke.

tenures.source: The VENUS Wrestling Alliance's own B1TCHIN' broadcast (30 December 2006): introduced as Debbie Mackey, she interviews Victoria Hawke before her match with Krist Blue.
